_comment: Synthetic DNS for the lab. Every address is a documentation address that already sits in a data/world.json pool: cloud_gcp (198.51.100.96/27) is where Google, Bing and Apple run, cloud_vm (203.0.113.0/26) hosts OpenAI, Anthropic, Perplexity and a slice of shared 'App Engine' egress, hosting_asn (203.0.113.64/26) is the attacker's rented allocation. Hostnames use the suffixes the operators really document. Identity is proven by DNS and ranges, never by pool membership: the edge hands every pool to every tenant.

patterns._comment: Whole blocks with generated names, like a hosting provider's default reverse zone. {d} is the IP with dots replaced by dashes. Addresses in no pattern and no explicit record have no PTR (most cloud VMs).
